selected_script.angle: A greasy range hood mesh filter looks clean after hot water, but the yellow oil stays trapped in the tiny holes until Liapu spray loosens the buildup and wipes through clearly.
selected_script.hook: Hot water and a brush are not getting this range hood filter clean.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of a greasy metal range hood mesh filter over a kitchen sink; an ordinary dish brush with warm water scrubs the yellow oil but it stays trapped in the mesh.
timeline.3-6s: The same brush scrubbing continues harder, spreading cloudy yellow residue and leaving greasy beads between the tiny holes; the user pauses with visible frustration.
timeline.6-10s: Liapu enters naturally beside the sink, sprays the same greasy mesh area, the user wipes with a paper towel, then tilts the filter to show a clean cleared strip next to the still-greasy section and ends with a light CTA.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad in 9:16, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a lived-in modern US kitchen with a stainless sink, warm natural kitchen light, slight hand shake, natural focus shifts, real cleaning sounds, no polished studio look. Use the provided product reference image as the exact product identity: Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser, white smooth plastic cylindrical spray bottle, yellow front-center label reading CLEAN UP KITCHEN OIL STAINS and NET: 500ml, trigger sprayer with nozzle, translucent bottle showing liquid level, ergonomic grip, standard 500ml proportions. Preserve product color, label placement, bottle shape, material, proportions, visible structure, nozzle, trigger, and translucent body exactly; do not invent accessories, extra buttons, lights, ports, decorations, alternate packaging, or product drift.

Timeline: 0-3s: Start with an extreme close-up, not a product shot. A greasy metal range hood mesh filter is held over the sink. Yellow-brown cooking oil is stuck in the tiny mesh holes. A familiar ordinary method fails: the user scrubs the same spot with a wet dish brush under a small stream of warm water. The brush moves back and forth, but the grease beads up and stays trapped in the mesh. Handheld phone camera is close enough to see the oily film and clogged holes. Natural voiceover: “Hot water and a brush are not getting this filter clean.”

3-6s: Continue the same failed method on the exact same greasy area. The user scrubs harder with the brush, making squeaky effort sounds, but it visibly amplifies the problem: cloudy yellow residue spreads across the mesh, oily water streaks run down, and some sticky grease clumps remain between the holes. The user’s hand pauses for a beat in mild frustration, showing the brush and still-dirty mesh in the same frame. Keep the look believable, no dramatic effects. Voiceover: “It just smears the oil deeper into the little holes.”

6-10s: The product enters naturally from the side of the sink, held by the user’s hand. Show the Liapu bottle front label briefly and clearly while keeping it in realistic use, then aim the trigger nozzle at the same greasy section of mesh and spray 2 short pumps. The liquid wets the oil naturally, with no magical dissolving or exaggerated chemical reaction. The user wipes the sprayed section with a plain white paper towel in two firm passes. Finish by tilting the same range hood filter toward the phone camera: one cleaned strip is visibly clearer and less yellow, with open-looking mesh holes, directly next to the still-greasy untouched section for a credible in-camera before-after contrast. The Liapu bottle remains visible near the sink edge with label facing camera. Light CTA voiceover: “If your hood filter gets like this, try Liapu.”

Strict negatives: no UI, no TikTok interface, no subtitles, no captions, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks, no split-screen, no poster layout, no floating icons, no arrows, no before-after labels, no generated graphics, no bacteria icons, no percentage text on screen, no invented cleaning tools beyond the ordinary dish brush and plain paper towel, no gloves unless already naturally present, no magical instant cleanup, no foaming explosion, no smoke, no glowing chemicals, no color-changing effect, no unrealistic sparkle burst. Cleaning must look physically credible from spraying and wiping the same stain. Keep all text only as real product label text that belongs on the reference bottle.
